title: johrenia alpina
intro: Johrenia alpina, commonly known as Alpine Johrenia, is a flowering plant in the parsley family, native to the Mediterranean region. The plant is used for its medicinal properties, which include a range of health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Johrenia alpina include pain relief, wound healing, and the management of various gastrointestinal issues. Bioactive constituents of Johrenia alpina include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
